capabilities: Pull Confluence pages into Markdown notes on manual trigger
Preview a read-only diff and choose Pull & Replace or Keep Local
Convert Confluence tables to Markdown or sanitized HTML
Download Confluence attachment images into the vault with limits and allowlists
Record the pulled page version in confluence-version frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a two-way Confluence sync or publisher; it has no write capability and only pulls pages into the vault.
extras: Desktop only (minAppVersion 1.13.0). Warns that the API token is stored unencrypted in data.json. Pre-1.0.8 versions had a push-to-Confluence feature that was removed entirely; since then the plugin is strictly one-way. Additional docs (FAQ, troubleshooting, workflow comparison) live in the repository.
problem: Teams whose documentation lives in Confluence have no built-in way to bring specific pages into Obsidian as local, searchable, offline Markdown.

relations.evidence: imports Confluence pages into local Markdown notes

requires.name: Confluence API token or personal access token
Atlassian account to create the API token

summary: One-way importer that pulls Confluence pages into local Markdown notes, showing a read-only diff preview before anything is written.
